pages.text: $(l)Large engines - $(item)Needs a Powered Shaft 2 blocks in front$():$() right-click the engine with a shaft to place it at the right spot, crossing the engine's direction. $(li)$(item)Needs Air in its air tank$(): pipe air from an Air Intake. $(li)$(item)No fuel$():

pipe fuel in. $(li)**Unsupported fuel: use diesel, kerosene, naphtha or furnace gas**: drain the tank, then refill with one of those. $(li)**Exhaust full: pump the CO2 away**. $(l)Small engines - $(item)Engine Unfinished$() with $(item)Next Component$():$() keep right-clicking parts in, one full set per block.

$(li)$(item)Pistons Missing$() / $(item)Turbines Missing$(): add cylinders or turbine blades. $(li)Gold line $(item)No output shaft$(): right-click an end block with a shaft (regular engines only; radial and turbine engines have theirs built in). $(li)**Signal: 0**: no redstone, so no rotation.
Power any block of the engine, or link an engine controller.$(br2)A small engine also stops, without a line of its own, when its exhaust tank is full or its fuel is not one its cylinders accept.
